items.title: Sam Altman said 'the world should accept some bad things happening' for the benefits of AI
items.summary: Sam Altman said he does not accept "the really catastrophic risks" of AI, believing that people will do "more good stuff than bad stuff."

items.title: Court tosses 10-year manslaughter sentence due to an AI-generated video of the victim ‘created from the imaginings’ of his sister
items.summary: In what’s believed to be a first in U.S. courts, Pelkey’s family used AI to create a video of his likeness to give him a voice.

items.summaryZh: 据信，这是美国法庭上的第一次，Pelkey的家人使用人工智能制作了一段他的肖像视频，让他说话。
